summary: This directory serves as the root public interface of the package, exporting the core static analysis pipeline and shared infrastructure utilities to provide a unified entry point for consumers.
responsibilities: Export the core static analysis pipeline and project orchestration capabilities.
Export foundational shared utilities for project identification, path resolution, and module mapping.
relationships: The root entry point aggregates both the analysis pipeline and shared utilities to expose a complete public interface.
Consumers access project analysis features and shared path resolution tools directly through this top-level export layer.
designDecisions: Re-exporting all public APIs from subdirectories through a single entry point to simplify consumer imports.
Strict separation between analysis orchestration and shared foundational utilities prior to public exposure.
